title: wauth
description: wAUTH is an ultra lightweight and high performance server security solution designed for Minecraft networks running Paper Purpur Spigot or CraftBukkit across versions 1.20.6 through 1.21.4 and above. The plugin eliminates the need for bulky external world
body:
Here is a polished, high-end, and deeply professional version of the Modrinth page. This layout strips out the informal commentary and transforms it into a top-tier premium resource page, perfect for attracting high-scale network owners.

🛡️ wAUTH
Network-Grade Virtual Isolation & Authentication Core
wAUTH is an ultra-lightweight, high-performance security solution built specifically for enterprise Minecraft networks running Paper, Purpur, or Spigot. By abandoning bloated external world managers, wAUTH completely isolates unauthenticated players into a dynamically managed, lag-free void environment—guaranteeing infrastructure-level security from the millisecond a player handshakes with your server.

Download Latest Release • Report an Issue

⚡ Technical Architecture & Core Features
📦 Automated Dynamic Provisioning Eliminates manual pre-configuration. On initialization, the plugin natively spins up an ultra-optimized, lightweight flat/void world (auth) with structure generation completely suppressed to minimize main-thread tick overhead.

🔒 Bi-Directional Chat Isolation Secures public communication channels completely. Unauthenticated sessions are restricted from broadcasting text packets. Concurrently, active global server chat is dynamically stripped from unauthenticated client streams, ensuring absolute data privacy.

🧬 Adaptive Multi-Version Engine Engineered with a runtime reflection bridge. A single compiled binary dynamically maps its execution pipeline to either the modern Paper AsyncChatEvent components or legacy Spigot AsyncPlayerChatEvent strings, depending on the host environment.

🟢 Native Adventure & MiniMessage Integration Supports full hex-color formatting and modern text design paradigms natively. Delivers synchronized screen titles, real-time visual action boss bars, and high-contrast diagnostic feedback out of the box.

💾 Enterprise Data Portability Maintains rigid compliance with existing database file structures. Upgrading the plugin engine core will never reset, alter, or impact existing user records (users.yml) or message configurations.
